rationale: PINS the SCD6 family (M37 #598): enum class_parameters mirror class class_parameters (handleClass parity). (1) The enum gets a constructor symbol and val-param property symbols (mass) — previously NO constructor and NO mass field existed for `enum Planet(val mass: Double)`. (2) The enum param's type clause emits a declared_type ref SOURCED TO THE ENUM (root -> Double was the KAD6-style unattributed twin — the collectDeclaredTypeRefs resolveSource did not know enum_definition).
